_about: AP-12 — OpenStreetMap shop / amenity value → HereMinder categories (grocery, hardware, pharmacy, electronics, general, garden, other) and a convenience flag. A value absent from both tables is UNMAPPED and listed under `unmapped` by build.py. big-format is not a property of a value alone: a row is `big` when its brand or name matches `big-format-brands.json` AND its kind is a big-store kind (build.py BIG_KINDS; AP-13 BI, review M1). amenity=fuel maps to `other` with convenience true, so it forms its own slice (fuel) in the size study. AP-13 BI (2026-09-26): the review's S3 values mapped (lumber/power_tools/building_supplies/home_improvement -> hardware; plants/nursery/garden_machinery -> garden; tractor/farm_supply/animal_feed/feed -> the agrarian triple; bulk_food/specialty_food/farmers_market/market -> grocery; drugstore -> pharmacy; appliances -> electronics; general_store -> general); shop=mobile_phone, cell_phones and mobile_phone_accessories -> other (carrier stores are not where a list item is bought, Planning 09-26).
